recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a hosted heartbeat check (Healthchecks.io or Cronitor) that the `nightly-sync` cron job pings on start and on success or failure, with push alerts on a miss or failure, and also changing the script to catch auth errors, send its own failure email and exit non-zero.
note: It rightly rejects the Synology/Docker log setup, but the script's own failure email is a second alert path on top of the heartbeat, so it is LARGER; none of the four labelled lines appear.
